entries.name: Short Obligatory Prayer
entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Chao quijena, O Arka K'séles chewe.
Chao illatana chi quijena, chi afsaksta.
Chao quijena laf, che keáp.
Chao chechal-eché, che keáp, chao akiai.
Chao tarso ak'senes, chao ala'ai. Che asár.
Chao ak'senes.
